item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json, copy, work\\nwith open('requests.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nexpected=[work.evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]\\nassert report == expected, (report, expected)\\nfor req in requests:\\n    req0=copy.deepcopy(req); pol0=copy.deepcopy(policy)\\n    result=work.evaluate(req, policy)\\n    assert set(result)=={'needs_review','changed'}\\n    assert req==req0 and policy==pol0\\nprint(json.dumps(expected, sort_keys=True))\"]}"}
